title: Start interactive placement of a PcbLib footprint
summary: Registers a .PcbLib with the Integrated Library server, finds a footprint by name and starts the PCB editor's interactive placement with IntegratedLibrary:PlaceComponent and the library and footprint GUIDs.
phrasings: place a footprint from a PcbLib on a board
list footprints in a PCB library
register a library file with the integrated library server
attach a footprint to the cursor for placement

commands.name: PlaceLibComponent
commands.description: Start interactive placement of a footprint from a .PcbLib
commands.params: PcbLibPath=<full path to .PcbLib> (required; menu: file dialog)|FootprintName=<name> (required, exact)

commands.name: ListLibFootprints
commands.params: PcbLibPath=<full path to .PcbLib> (required; menu: file dialog)
